_note: The document list a case type declares for the completeness of an application (DqZaakDocumenten, Volledigheid van de aanvraag). Each item is answered by a document of the case (its informatieobjecttype, or a word in its title or file name) or by a case field. GET /api/cases/{caseId}/completeness ticks them. A fragment per ADR-037.

completenessItems.title: Completeness of the application
completenessItems.description: What an application of this type must hold before it is admissible. Each item is ticked by a document of the case or by a case field.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: The informatieobjecttype of a case document that answers this item.

documentTitleContains.title: Word in the document title
documentTitleContains.description: A case document whose title or file name holds this word answers this item.

field.title: Case field
field.description: A case field (dot path) whose value answers this item.

evidence.title: Evidence text
evidence.description: What the card shows when the field answers the item, e.g. where the data came from. Defaults to the field's value.
